description: This file is a shell script that automates the build, patching, testing, and coverage report generation for the entservices appgateway project. It manages cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring CMake builds for multiple components, executing unit tests, collecting coverage data, and staging built plugins. The script is a comprehensive build and test pipeline tailored for continuous integration in a CI/CD environment.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs informational messages with a prefix.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs warning messages directed to standard error.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Logs error messages directed to standard error.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks for the availability of a command in PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Determines if the script is running with root privileges.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Checks if 'apt-get' can be run (i.e., sudo or root privileges are available).

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs 'apt-get' with non-interactive options, with optional sudo escalation.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs a command and logs a warning if it fails, without stopping the script.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Ensures that a git repository is checked out at a specific ref or tag.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if absent or reclones if forced, then checks out a specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file idempotently to a repository directory.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks whether a build directory has been configured with CMake.

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristically determines if a component is installed based on directory contents.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a CMake project with specified options.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
methods.description: Configures and builds a CMake project without installation step (used for testing).
